mainEntity.name: What permits might be needed for outdoor refrigerator installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permits for outdoor refrigerator installation are typically required if new electrical circuits are being run, or if the installation is part of a larger outdoor kitchen construction project that involves structural changes or significant utility work. Simple plug-and-play installations for existing outlets usually do not require permits. As a licensed contractor, Hometelligent Inc. handles all necessary permit applications for clients in areas like Berkeley and Oakland, ensuring all work complies with local building and electrical codes.
